description:
BEAUTIFUL 3 BEDROOM FAMILY HOME CLOSE TO CITY CENTRE

Savills is delighted to present this charming three-bedroom semi-detached home, originally built in 1951 and beautifully upgraded and maintained over the years. Cúl Álainn is in excellent condition, offering generous living accommodation, mature gardens, and a superb location close to both Douglas Village and Cork City Centre.

The property is approached via a spacious front garden that provides ample private parking. To the side sits a detached garage (2.85m x 5m), perfect for storage, a workshop, or with potential for conversion to a home office, studio, or additional accommodation (SPP). Mature hedging frames the site, creating a welcoming sense of privacy.

Inside, a wide entrance hall leads to a bright and well-proportioned sitting room overlooking the front garden. To the rear, a comfortable living room enjoys views of the garden and direct access to a sunny patio. The property has been thoughtfully extended, creating a spacious open-plan kitchen and dining area, complete with a fully fitted kitchen and patio doors opening onto the rear garden. A convenient downstairs bathroom with complete sanitary wear and shower, along with a small utility cabinet plumbed for washing machine and dryer, completes the ground floor layout.

Upstairs are three well-sized bedrooms, all filled with natural light, along with a family bathroom. The accommodation is practical, balanced and ideally suited to modern family living.

The rear garden is a real highlight, extending almost 60 metres in length. Wonderfully private and sunny, it is adorned with hedging, shrubs, apple trees, roses, and even a pond tucked away at the far end. This expansive garden provides ample space for children to play, for keen gardeners to enjoy, or for those wishing to extend the home further. It is a safe and tranquil haven, perfect for relaxing on long summer days.

Cúl Álainn is tucked away in a quiet cul-de-sac of just four houses, giving it a secluded feel while being only 2.4km from Cork City Centre and 1.2km from Douglas Village. 

The location benefits from a host of amenities including shops, schools, restaurants, cafés, sports clubs and more. With oil-fired central heating and high-speed fibre broadband, the property is fully equipped for contemporary living.

Cúl Álainn truly is a hidden gem. Combining character, comfort and convenience in one of Cork's most sought-after residential areas, this delightful property makes the ideal family home.
